messages.author: 697cdfacf5b0f418
messages.subject: CPO in Nimble
parts:
Hi Nimble experts,

I am wondering if we can generate the conditional predictive ordinate (CPO) value from nimble?

Many thanks!
Bill

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: CPO in Nimble
parts:
Hi Bill,

CPO uses leave-one-out fitting, so it's not something we provide directly in NIMBLE. You could of course program it, but fitting all the MCMCs as a brute force approach would of course be computationally demanding.

-chris
